explanation: Keep the FIFO values and a nonincreasing deque of maximum candidates. A newly appended value eliminates smaller trailing candidates; dequeue removes a candidate only when that exact front value leaves. Equal maxima are retained separately.
spaceComplexity: O(n) logical entries, plus bounded deque block caches
attribution: Original Python implementation authored for EPI Practice from its displayed contract and independently authored C# solution; no upstream reference source adapted.
